message.content: {"verdict":"PAY","cited_clauses":[1,2,5,6],"reasons":[{"clause":1,"finding":"The invoice bills only days worked in the billing month at a day rate that does not exceed the agreement.","evidence_quote":"FACTS: \"Days billed: 10, within the 16-day monthly cap.\" and \"Day rate billed does not exceed the agreed 380 USDC.\"; invoice: \"Billing period: 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31\""},{"clause":2,"finding":"The invoice does not exceed the monthly cap in the agreement.","evidence_quote":"FACTS: \"Days billed: 10, within the 16-day monthly cap.\""},{"clause":5,"finding":"The invoice is not a duplicate of work already paid.","evidence_quote":"FACTS: \"No other invoice on file covers this invoice number or period.\""},{"clause":6,"finding":"The invoice was received within 60 days of the end of the billing period.","evidence_quote":"FACTS: \"Received 2026-09-05, 5 days after the billing period ended (2026-08-31).\""}],"policy_covers":true,"suspected_manipulation":false}
